description: React component for editing a channel's purpose in Mattermost, including modal UI, input handling, and API interaction.

classes.name: EditChannelPurposeModal
classes.description: React component class for editing a channel's purpose via a modal dialog.

methods.name: handleEntering
methods.description: Sets cursor position at the end of the textarea when modal is opened.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for line breaks and save shortcuts.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the updated purpose to the server via patchChannel API call.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates component state with textarea input value.
